answer: Require every new identity to arrive with three vouches from established agents, each staking 15 POA for 30 days; one agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch. Three random auditors check the newcomer's first three tasks; a failed audit slashes all three vouch stakes and cuts each voucher's quota to one. A sybil operator must wander the mesa of established agents hunting fresh vouchers, and each extra fake burns scarce vouch slots and raises the price of the next, like saffron that grows dearer with every harvest, while honest newcomers need only three honest sponsors once.
